parent_waves.H139: selection/winner's-curse audit framework and exact native endpoint

arm_roles.G3175: primary and co-primary (frozen GATED_025 recipe on r3175 base)
arm_roles.G882: H217 GATED_025 recipe on r882 (replication anchor on fresh folds)
arm_roles.G3175_DIS: H129 disagreement placebo on r3175, report-only
arm_roles.B3175: ungated lambda=0.25 blend on r3175, report-only
arm_roles.B882: ungated lambda=0.25 blend on r882, report-only

gate.primary_signal: zgap = (base[b]-base[a])/std(base), a/b = first argmin of base/blend; 0 if same pick; costs only
gate.placebo_signal: H129 disagreement = 1 - Spearman(GBM, base) over unrevealed slots
gate.selection: per cell, FIT only (inner OOF calibrated GBM): max FIT equal-family native gain over arm's own base (R3175 or R882) s.t. FIT harm <= 0.05; ties -> smaller tau; closed always feasible

decision.primary: CONFIRMED: G3175 iff LCB95>0 AND 3/3 seeds positive AND harm<=10% vs R882 (205 families, pooled-A native, 10k paired family-cluster bootstrap); else NOT_CONFIRMED
decision.co_primary: PLATEAU_WIN iff DL-Val91 context-mean gain of G3175 vs R882 > +0.002 AND family-bootstrap LCB95 > 0 AND G3175-vs-R3175 DL-Val91 family-bootstrap LCB95 > 0; ties not a win; else NO_PLATEAU_WIN

host: xbabe2 CPU only (admission before any side effect); no GPU, no GPU claim

guards.worker_affinity: whole-tree affinity <= 4 cores (os.sched_setaffinity, OMP_NUM_THREADS=4, tree cap 4.5 cores over 30 s)
guards.admission: load1 <= 60, load5 <= 55, host CPU <= 50%, MemAvailable >= 24 GiB, disk free >= 320 GB; refusal = no claim
guards.runtime_aborts: MemAvailable < 20 GiB, disk free < 300 GB, RSS >= 4 GiB, worker affinity > 4 cores, worker tree > 4.5 cores over 30 s, or compute stop 18:30Z
guards.load_pause: load5 > 60 pauses worker (SIGSTOP / sleep), rechecks every 60 s, resumes at load5 <= 55
guards.deadline: absolute: min(attempt claim + 4 h, 2026-11-02T18:30:00Z = 1793644200.0); hard closeout 19:00Z
